instruction: An account starts with 1000 dollars. It earns 7 percent interest per year, compounded monthly (the monthly rate is the annual rate divided by 12). How much money is in the account after 5 years, in whole cents (rounded to the nearest cent)? Compute it with the bash tool (python3 -c). Work only inside the current directory. When you are done, write ONLY the final answer to the file answer.txt in the current directory (for example with bash: echo 42 > answer.txt).
